# CASHIO.US — Sovereign AI Under Human Command

> Doug Cashio, Pensacola, Florida. Principal solutions consultant with 20+ years in enterprise environments. This site documents ZeusApollo, an independently built sovereign AI system: owned hardware, quality gated model routing, measured cost, and public safe proof. Every published figure is dated, scoped, and expires on purpose.

Current release: v40 "Aurora". Figures verified August 1, 2026 by an owner run live check over cluster SSH; valid 30 days or until the next architecture change. Machine readable figures: https://cashio.us/status.json

## The system

- Two core homelab hosts run 19 documented containers (19 of 19 verified running at the August 1, 2026 check). Athena is a physical edge and quorum device; quorum 3 of 3. Atlas is a standalone local inference host, deliberately counted outside the container total.
- Ten model lanes route by a single law: quality gates the route, cost only decides the tie. Free and local lanes carry routine work; frontier adjudication activates only when consequence earns it.
- Observed AI cost: $0.26 per day, $6.49 per month estimated, from a dated sample.
- DNS resolves on owned hardware against 216,108 blocklist entries; 14.4% of 219,628 queries in the 24 hour sample blocked at source. Backups: 18 of 19 containers inside 24 hours, restore verified. Security updates due: 0.
